sources.note: Main homepage. Highlights Expanse as 'The Intelligent EHR', mentions key customers (HCA Healthcare 190+ hospitals, Humber River Health, Willis Knighton, Frederick Health, UPMC Ireland, Centre for Neuro Skills). Mentions MaaS, AI, Traverse Exchange interoperability.

ONC certification/compliance page. Lists all certified products across Expanse 2.2, 2.1, 6.1, 6.0, MAGIC, and Client/Server platforms. Reveals separately certified modules: CCD interface, MyHealth Portal, Public Health Interfaces (immunization, syndromic surveillance, reportable labs, electronic case reporting, cancer reporting), Oncology, and MPM (Medical and Practice Management) for MAGIC and C/S.

Complete product list page. Lists all modules across Clinical, Diagnostic Services, Care Coordination, Specialty Care, Revenue Cycle, and Business Operations categories. Critical source for understanding the full scope of the integrated platform.

Expanse product page. Details customer deployments (HCA, Emanate Health, Hebrew SeniorLife, Bethany Children's, Centre for Neuro Skills, Fraser Health, Blackrock Health, Aga Khan University Hospital). Describes Surveillance analytics, Genomics, Traverse Exchange, Revenue Cycle, BCA, AI/ambient listening, mobile apps.

Tegria (MEDITECH implementation partner) comprehensive guide to Expanse. Detailed feature descriptions including Care Delivery (Expanse Now, Genomics, Telehealth, Virtual Care), Patient Engagement (portal, MHealth app, Health Records on iPhone, Patient Connect), Specialty Care (ED, Oncology, L&D), Interoperability (Traverse, Care Compass, Case Management), Analytics (BCA, Surveillance, Revenue Cycle, Quality Vantage), Security, and Innovation (Virtual Assistant, Google Workspace, Cloud Platform). Compares Licensed vs. MaaS deployment.
Becker's Hospital Review on MEDITECH market share trends. Reports ~14.8% U.S. acute care market share in 2024, third behind Epic and Oracle Health.
KLAS market share data. MEDITECH at 14.8% of hospitals, 12.7% of beds. Epic at 42.3%/54.9%, Oracle at 22.9%/22.1%.
Reports 63% of legacy MEDITECH customers making new EHR decisions in 2024 chose to stay with MEDITECH by migrating to Expanse.
MEDITECH press release on 11th consecutive Best in KLAS recognition. #1 in Acute Care EHR (Small 1-150 Bed) for 6th year, top positions in Patient Accounting, Ambulatory EHR, Practice Management.

CereCore guide on transitioning from MEDITECH legacy (MAGIC/C/S) to Expanse. Describes MAGIC as MUMPS-based green-screen, C/S as thick-client, both siloed with limited integration. Expanse as web-based, cloud-ready, mobile-first.
Wikipedia entry on MEDITECH. Founded 1969, headquartered Westwood MA, privately held, ~$494M revenue (2019), MUMPS/MIIS language origins.

PatientKeeper integration with MEDITECH Expanse press release. PatientKeeper provides mobile access to patient data over MEDITECH systems (both MAGIC and Expanse). Relevant to understanding the HCA MAGIC deployment.
Becker's on HCA Healthcare's Expanse rollout progress. HCA measured success after 43-hospital Expanse deployment, migrating from MAGIC.
HCA Healthcare magazine on their transition to cloud-hosted MEDITECH Expanse from legacy MAGIC.
KLAS Research vendor rating page for MEDITECH. Customer reviews highlight flexibility, partnership, value, and comprehensive solution.
